channel.title: OpenStill
channel.description: OpenStill updates. scripts/release.sh adds an item for each release.

item.title: OpenStill 0.0.2
item.description:
What’s new in 0.0.2

  • Perspective correction with Upright (Auto, Level, Vertical, Full, Guided) in the new Transform tool
  • Camera profiles, DCP import and calibration in the new Profile & calibration tool
  • RAW decoding options: demosaic method and noise reduction
  • Library catalog for faster opening, with an Include subfolders option
  • Color labels (keys 6–9), title, caption, keywords and other metadata, with presets
  • Collections and smart collections, and search across keywords, camera and lens
  • Saved previews so the library shows edited photos without re-rendering

item.title: OpenStill 0.0.3
item.description:
What’s new in 0.0.3

  • Select with AI: subject, background, people, individual people, face, eyes, eyebrows, lips, skin, sky and depth masks
  • Lens Blur: depth-driven background blur from camera depth, AI depth or the subject
  • AI RAW denoise that keeps every edit adjustable, and 2× super resolution
  • Smoother local AI results with no tile seams
  • Import from a memory card or folder with renaming, backups, presets and duplicate detection
  • Find exact and near-duplicate photos
  • Read and write XMP sidecars, and import Camera Raw settings
  • Import a Lightroom Classic catalog: folders, ratings, labels, keywords, collections and develop settings
